description:
Variation of condition 2 (Approved Plans), condition 4 (Waste and Bike Storages), condition 5 (Landscaping) and condition 6 (Boundary Treatment) attached to planning permission reference 201461 granted 06/07/2021 to allow for following changes:- Natural Slates instead of Zinc.- Triple glazed velux windows instead of Neo Rooflights- Flat section of roof to be changed to grey fibre glass.- To amend the front elevation windows at first floor level to two windows of the same
size.-Amendment to the front door, to allow for a glazed panel.- Replace the rain water down pipe with surface mounted rain water
down pipe. UPVC 110mm half round 65mm
recessed pipe in white.- Replace the proposed valley roof to the front elevation with the
traditional facia and 110mm half round UPVC gutter.- Rearrange the interior layout of the house to remove the change
in level between the kitchen and the living room and provide appropriate fire escape
from upper floors past the ground floor kitchen in accordance with current building
regulations.- Change the ground floor kitchen window detail to simplify the construction and
improve the insulation of the front elevation. - To relocate the refuse bins and bicycle storage as indicated on the proposed plan and
amend the soft and hard landscaping and new walls and gates and fencing.
